title: Transformer

paper.title: Attention Is All You Need
paper.year_note: Original/preprint year except GCN (2017 venue, 2016 preprint) and speculative decoding (2023 venue, 2022 preprint).

statement: Implement Transformer: derive numerically stable scaled dot-product attention and explicit mask semantics. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This task isolates scaled dot-product attention, not the complete translation system. Boolean masks use True for allowed keys; additive masks are added before softmax; entirely masked rows must return zero. Use attention-equivalence; required output: forward(q,k,v,mask=None) -> attention output. Evaluate attention_max_error (minimize). Compare SDPA values and gradients including non-square and fully masked cases. Required ablation: Remove the inverse-square-root key-width scale and compare scores and gradient norms.

dataset.name: attention-equivalence
dataset.description: Compare SDPA values and gradients including non-square and fully masked cases
dataset.split_policy: Disjoint train/validation/test examples; fit preprocessing using training data only.

budget.note: Provisional safety caps, not empirically calibrated GPU budgets.

metric.name: attention_max_error
metric.target_status: provisional draft targets only; threshold remains null until calibration

interface.data: dict with train and val torch.utils.data.TensorDataset entries
interface.objective: Compare SDPA values and gradients including non-square and fully masked cases

checks: Return a Submission containing a torch module.
Do not read validation labels during fitting.
No NaN or infinite outputs; obey parameter cap.
Compare masked/unmasked outputs and gradients with PyTorch SDPA.

ablation.change: Remove the inverse-square-root key-width scale and compare scores and gradient norms
ablation.control: Same split, seed, training steps and optimizer.
ablation.report: Report metric and parameter/time deltas honestly; do not infer superiority from one seed.

hints: derive numerically stable scaled dot-product attention and explicit mask semantics
Write down every intermediate tensor shape before implementing the block.
Start with the smallest deterministic fixture and compare with a trusted primitive.

calibration.note: No GPU calibration performed; no passing threshold advertised.
